nodes.label: Dubbing Studio Page
nodes.rationale: Clone the voice, swap the words, re-lip-sync. 3-step flow (transcribe -> new script -> dub) with a local/free engine (XTTS v2 + Wav2Lip) vs cloud/paid engine (fal.ai F5/MiniMax voice + LatentSync/MuseTalk/VEED/sync v2 lips). Calls /api/overview, /api/script, /api/run, /api/job, /api/upload; parses '=== stage: X ===' job log lines into a 3-box progress UI.

nodes.label: Explicit Cost-Approval Gate for Paid Runs
nodes.rationale: Design principle repeated across Creator, Dubbing, and Mission Control: any run that spends money on fal.ai shows an itemized confirm() dialog and only proceeds with confirm_cost=true in the request body; free/local paths are labeled '$0'. A header spend badge tracks cumulative fal.ai cost so the operator always knows totals.

nodes.label: Local Free Dubbing Pipeline (XTTS v2 + Wav2Lip)
nodes.rationale: Clones the speaker's voice and speaks the new script on the local GPU (XTTS v2), optionally lip-syncing with Wav2Lip or Wav2Lip+GFPGAN HD - no network, $0. Hybrid mode keeps the free local voice and pays only for cloud lip-sync (LatentSync), positioned as best value against full-cloud tiers.

nodes.label: fal.ai Cloud Generation Service
nodes.rationale: Paid cloud provider used for TTS voice (F5 zero-shot, MiniMax turbo/HD with $1.50 one-time clone), lip-sync (LatentSync/MuseTalk ~$0.20/40s, VEED ~$0.40/min, sync v2 ~$3/min, sync v2 PRO), and video shot generation (Wan 2.2, Seedance, Hailuo, Kling). Every page surfaces per-tier price labels and total spend.
